notes.title: 24/01/27 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Preface
For those of you who are interested in trying out Alpha League early. Our Playtest Server is now open to public. If you want to join, simply apply for the Playtest on Store Page. 

We are expecting a server maintenance around Jan. 27th 10am CET/1am PST/5pm BJT. The maintenance will continue for about 1 hour. Like every week before, please restart Steam to update the game client.

Part. 1 Content
1. We have temporarily retired Marble, because we cannot fix his texture issue for the moment. We apologize to those who love Marble, and we expect Marble to be back soon.
2. A new hero - the North Berserker "Eyvar" is available for play now. Please check for details in Library. Eyvar is tanky and mainly deals damage by critical hits.

Part. 2 Balance
1. Buff: the healing amount for Adrenaline (Heal Genre Legendary Skill) has been 33% increased.
2. Rework: talents (passive skill) of Jenny and Alicia are stronger now in early game (because we find new players may fail 1-7 monster round with these 2 heroes) and slightly weaker in late game.
3. Reworked mechanism of Credit card. You can always overdraft now.
4. Buffed damage of Damage Reflection (Shield+Curse Normal Skill), check out in library.
5. You can now pick identical heroes.

Part. 3 Miscellaneous
1. Fixed reconnection issue. When players quit lobby or are disconnected for a long time, they should still be able to reconnect. Especially when play as a team.
2. Tweaked the Elo System. It will be easier for a good player to climb the ladder. However, when a player loses, he or she also loses more elo points.
3. Improved Bot intelligence. New players should be able to experience a smoother learning curve.
4. Improved UI in several places. We will keep improving the UI.
5. Keep improving performance on earlier specs computers.
6. Fixed sound effect bug for Opal.
7. Fixed all the known bugs.
8. Fixed some text mistakes.

Expectation for next week
1. Allocate more currency resources (through Rank Rewards and so on) to players, so cultivating a few main heroes will be faster.
2. We will try to fix the Steamdeck compatibility issue.
3. Lobby UI upgrade (as surveyed earlier at Discord/Reddit).
4. We are planning about new heroes/genres/artifacts/maps before the official release, but this may taker longer than next week. Thank you for being patient with us. We hope you enjoy the time with Pals.

notes.title: Patch Notes (2024/01/19 Version 0.1.20)
notes.notes:
IMPORTANT – change of CBT rules
After eight days of conducting the CBT, we are thrilled to see that our players’ passion has far exceeded our expectations. Some of our players have already played for more than 100 hours. It feels like so much more than just a playtest to us. To show our appreciation for your support, we have decided that although we will still reset the rank elo by the end of the playtest, all playtest players can keep their hero levels, cosmetics, currencies, and hero shards when the official server is online. Nonetheless, all in-app purchase policies remain valid – we will still offer a 200% reward for any payment activities. Thanks again for your support.

Part #1 – New Content
1.	Added 2 new maps (check in library) – 1. Hell Shrine; 2. Necro Earth Office
2.	Added 16 new artifacts (check in library) – 1. Balance Force; 2. Credit Card; 3. Gaze of the Elder; 4. Credit Loans; 5. Easter Egg; 6. Fencing Exercise; 7. Mind Exercise; 8. Pace Exercise; 9. Lifting Exercise; 10. Meditation Exercise; 11. Polar Exercise; 12. Alchemy Exercise; 13. Blocking Exercise; 14. Faith Exercise; 15. Warlock Exercise; 16. Book of Chance

Part #2 – Balance
1.	Crit/Evasion triggered skills were slightly buffed.
2.	Added probability to all Heal/Shield/Curse triggered skills.
3.	Crystal Blade: probability +100%, damage -50%.
4.	Shuffling related artifacts were slightly buffed.
5.	-5 gold discount for “start spinning”.
6.	Nana’s Mystic Form duration +1s, Attack Speed and Attack Damage coefficients +1, and animation time is now faster
7.	Sylvie’s Windwalk cooldown -1s, Storm shot base damage +50.
8.	Marble’s Lifecut damage coefficient +4%.
9.	Moriatee is now stronger in early game and weaker in late game now, both ult and talent got tweaked (check in library).
10.	Shield/Heal Ultimate Duration -1s, trigger interval changed to 0.1s, total effect amounts unchanged.
11.	Profitable becomes a unique artifact.
12.	Night owl was slightly buffed.
13.	The damage reduction proportion for Talisman, Body Armor, Enhanced Vaccine +5%.
14.	Preparation phase timer +5 seconds.
15.	Bedivere’s ultimate animation is now faster

Part #3 – Miscellaneous
1.	Added “Slow Mode” to Bot Match and Tutorial for comprehensive reading.
2.	Added tooltips for frost/poison/shield/curse buffs.
3.	When your ultimate is Disintegrated by Judie, your mana bar becomes black now.
4.	When you are immune to control, the frost stacks become red.
5.	Updated cloak texture for Jacquelyn.
6.	Changed Simplified Chinese Font.
7.	Changed UI color for Tutorial.
8.	Added CD-Key function which you can find in the “activities” button, which is a giftbox icon.
9.	Fixed all the detected bugs.
10.	Fixed some text and localization issues.
11.	Fixed some sound effect issues.
